inspection_scope: all 500 straightened crops in 25 contact sheets; selected examples recorded; not glyph-by-glyph gold adjudication
observations: Library/stamp-like watermark crosses the main text and survives the geometric/catalogue gates; readers may read or suppress it differently. Examples: [line 107](pilot_review.html#anemi-727f1e3f8d0a3a622943e9b1-v96f8cbde-p000065-l0003) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-727f1e3f8d0a3a622943e9b1-v96f8cbde-p000065-l0003.straight.png)), [line 214](pilot_review.html#anemi-b4bb45a610fbcbc974b0eb32-v8f762ccc-p000032-l0002) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-b4bb45a610fbcbc974b0eb32-v8f762ccc-p000032-l0002.straight.png)), [line 441](pilot_review.html#anemi-ca065d129a9bd4a73ad7a9a2-v115e8a73-p000163-l0003) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-ca065d129a9bd4a73ad7a9a2-v115e8a73-p000163-l0003.straight.png)).

Neighbour accents/letter fragments remain at a crop edge despite a single main fitted band. The 50% visible-neighbour threshold misses small slivers. Examples: [line 67](pilot_review.html#anemi-1697d5cc21fa26717b97e073-v1d3645ab-p000106-l0041) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-1697d5cc21fa26717b97e073-v1d3645ab-p000106-l0041.straight.png)), [line 68](pilot_review.html#anemi-1697d5cc21fa26717b97e073-v1d3645ab-p000106-l0062) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-1697d5cc21fa26717b97e073-v1d3645ab-p000106-l0062.straight.png)), [line 70](pilot_review.html#anemi-1697d5cc21fa26717b97e073-v1d3645ab-p000107-l0058) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-1697d5cc21fa26717b97e073-v1d3645ab-p000107-l0058.straight.png)).

Greek and German parallel columns were fused into one horizontal row. Box-centre column inference and the same-band list join rule do not detect this semantic cross-column error. Examples: [line 177](pilot_review.html#anemi-39efef08912bdefa01efa90d-v5c05ae52-p000023-l0038) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-39efef08912bdefa01efa90d-v5c05ae52-p000023-l0038.straight.png)), [line 178](pilot_review.html#anemi-39efef08912bdefa01efa90d-v5c05ae52-p000024-l0011) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-39efef08912bdefa01efa90d-v5c05ae52-p000024-l0011.straight.png)), [line 179](pilot_review.html#anemi-39efef08912bdefa01efa90d-v5c05ae52-p000024-l0012) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-39efef08912bdefa01efa90d-v5c05ae52-p000024-l0012.straight.png)).

Relative width passes on a narrow poem/list band although the line contains few words. The 80% band rule does not guarantee long prose in absolute character count. Examples: [line 233](pilot_review.html#anemi-928e34aaaa78469aacd6c7ef-vdcf1df66-p000029-l0002) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-928e34aaaa78469aacd6c7ef-vdcf1df66-p000029-l0002.straight.png)), [line 247](pilot_review.html#anemi-cc5059bc91ca2b178c20008c-v549fc824-p000026-l0027) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-cc5059bc91ca2b178c20008c-v549fc824-p000026-l0027.straight.png)), [line 249](pilot_review.html#anemi-cc5059bc91ca2b178c20008c-v549fc824-p000026-l0042) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-cc5059bc91ca2b178c20008c-v549fc824-p000026-l0042.straight.png)).

Broken/faint ink and partly missing strokes remain in passing crops. A high darkest-percentile contrast can coexist with locally unreadable characters. Examples: [line 346](pilot_review.html#anemi-1c3c81f346537e276486e9fd-v770c6f3b-p000021-l0058) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-1c3c81f346537e276486e9fd-v770c6f3b-p000021-l0058.straight.png)), [line 373](pilot_review.html#anemi-2c8742589d947f8d749c7ba2-v83646daf-p000024-l0028) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-2c8742589d947f8d749c7ba2-v83646daf-p000024-l0028.straight.png)), [line 374](pilot_review.html#anemi-2c8742589d947f8d749c7ba2-v83646daf-p000024-l0030) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-2c8742589d947f8d749c7ba2-v83646daf-p000024-l0030.straight.png)).

Some passing straightened strips still show residual tilt/bend or uneven baselines; mean body-clipping diagnostics do not certify every letter edge. Examples: [line 353](pilot_review.html#anemi-f3cfa262eedab9cd43a9e412-v3391de81-p000152-l0008) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-f3cfa262eedab9cd43a9e412-v3391de81-p000152-l0008.straight.png)), [line 355](pilot_review.html#anemi-f3cfa262eedab9cd43a9e412-v3391de81-p000153-l0023) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-f3cfa262eedab9cd43a9e412-v3391de81-p000153-l0023.straight.png)), [line 498](pilot_review.html#anemi-cbe5e7b92d36edf08153017b-v3a0038ff-p000124-l0069) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-cbe5e7b92d36edf08153017b-v3a0038ff-p000124-l0069.straight.png)).

French, Latin, German and Italian quotations/text occur in the proposed Greek books. Latin script is allowed by the garbage rule; el+grc hints may be a mismatch. Examples: [line 46](pilot_review.html#anemi-b7a2ad096ab8ab67b203d3cd-v646bf5b0-p000061-l0019) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-b7a2ad096ab8ab67b203d3cd-v646bf5b0-p000061-l0019.straight.png)), [line 117](pilot_review.html#anemi-bc780ca03714543a92331cd2-vb9d7a49c-p000181-l0021) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-bc780ca03714543a92331cd2-vb9d7a49c-p000181-l0021.straight.png)), [line 207](pilot_review.html#anemi-238fe0dd99ba050f9501d778-v98c049fe-p000121-l0030) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-238fe0dd99ba050f9501d778-v98c049fe-p000121-l0030.straight.png)), [line 310](pilot_review.html#anemi-c10815de32006dc7d7354073-vecd51f4c-p000030-l0025) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-c10815de32006dc7d7354073-vecd51f4c-p000030-l0025.straight.png)), [line 487](pilot_review.html#anemi-2b1d2b5340150ddc135a2b1a-v94a9e1f7-p000094-l0041) ([crop](pilot_review_images/anemi-2b1d2b5340150ddc135a2b1a-v94a9e1f7-p000094-l0041.straight.png)).
